scope: Pinned exact two-body COM event formulas with supplied K and explicit zeta ledger; actual source rows and arithmetic guards
basis: Static equation/code review plus read-only inspection of the single parent-leased independent numerical receipt
reject_if: independent event energy or momentum invariant fails
explicit zeta partition or incoming-K debit fails
source guard or admitted-domain rejection fails
thermal particle ownership is inferred silently
inconclusive_if: numerical or lease execution evidence is missing
independent oracle coverage is missing for an asserted case
reviewed and executed verifier identities cannot be bound

nonblocking_observations.finding: Rejected malformed decimal text sets the caller InvalidOperation flag and has trap-dependent ValueError wording. Valid outputs and context state remain isolated.
nonblocking_observations.scope_limit: No claim that every rejected input preserves caller context flags or stable message text

not_established: independent experimental mass or photon validation
thermal particle membership or stopping closure
normal-frame transport or radiation stress tensor
uniform interval certificate beyond sampled cases
